# SpriteAnimationExtensions

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Animation` · class

```csharp
public static class SpriteAnimationExtensions
```

Extension methods that build [`SpriteAnimation`](SpriteAnimation.md)s from texture atlases and draw [`SpriteAnimationPlayer`](SpriteAnimationPlayer.md)s.

## Methods

### CreateAnimation

```csharp
public static SpriteAnimation CreateAnimation(this TextureAtlas atlas, string name, float framesPerSecond, PlaybackMode playback = PlaybackMode.Loop)
```

Types: [`SpriteAnimation`](SpriteAnimation.md), [`TextureAtlas`](TextureAtlas.md), [`PlaybackMode`](PlaybackMode.md)

Creates an animation from the atlas regions named `<name>_<number>`, in numeric order.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `atlas` | The atlas holding the frames. |
| `name` | The animation's name: the frame names before their last `_`. |
| `framesPerSecond` | The frame rate. Must be positive and finite. |
| `playback` | How the animation plays through its frames. |

**Throws `KeyNotFoundException`:** The atlas has no frames for `name`.

**Throws `InvalidDataException`:** Two frames have the same number.

Call it once when the atlas is loaded and keep the result.

### Draw

```csharp
public static void Draw(this SpriteBatch spriteBatch, SpriteAnimationPlayer player, Vector2 position, Color color, Angle rotation = default, Vector2 origin = default, Vector2? scale = null, SpriteFlip flip = SpriteFlip.None)
```

Types: [`SpriteBatch`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md), [`SpriteAnimationPlayer`](SpriteAnimationPlayer.md), [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md), [`Angle`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Angle.md), [`SpriteFlip`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteFlip.md)

Queues a player's current frame to be drawn during this batch. Does nothing when the player has no animation.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `spriteBatch` | The sprite batch. |
| `player` | The player whose frame is drawn. |
| `position` | Where the origin is drawn. |
| `color` | The color tint. |
| `rotation` | The rotation around the origin. |
| `origin` | The pivot in the frame's logical coordinates, from its top-left corner. |
| `scale` | The scale, or `null` for none. A negative component mirrors the frame about the origin: `new Vector2(-1, 1)` faces it the other way, in place with the origin at its center. |
| `flip` | Mirrors the image inside its logical (untrimmed) rectangle, which doesn't move: it flips in place whatever the origin, and a trimmed frame's pixels land mirrored where they belong. |

The frame is drawn trim-aware, like any atlas region, so the origin is in the frame's logical (untrimmed) coordinates. [`SpriteBatch.Begin`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md#begin) must be called before this method.

### GetAnimationFrames

```csharp
public static IReadOnlyList<TextureRegion> GetAnimationFrames(this TextureAtlas atlas, string name)
```

Types: [`TextureRegion`](TextureRegion.md), [`TextureAtlas`](TextureAtlas.md)

Gets the atlas regions named `<name>_<number>`, in numeric order, for building an animation with per-frame holds.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `atlas` | The atlas holding the frames. |
| `name` | The animation's name: the frame names before their last `_`. |

**Throws `KeyNotFoundException`:** The atlas has no frames for `name`.

**Throws `InvalidDataException`:** Two frames have the same number.

Frame numbers are compared as numbers, so `run_2` comes before `run_10` however they're padded. They needn't start at 0 or be contiguous. Names are compared without case, like all atlas lookups.
